title: Suqah Slayer Guide (60k SLAYER XP/HR) OSRS
summary: A guide to Suqah Slayer tasks on Lunar Isle using a cannon. Gnomonkey says they are terrible for loot but give a clean 60k Slayer XP an hour and are a short task from Duradel.

outline.text: Introduction, XP, task length and requirements
Fastest way to get to the Suqah

claims.text: Gnomonkey says Suqah give a clean 60k Slayer XP an hour, but their only drops are from the rare drop table.
Suqah tasks from Duradel are incredibly short, each taking about ten minutes, and have a weight of eight, so they come up fairly often.
Suqah have no requirements to fight, but to be assigned them the player needs to have progressed Lunar Diplomacy up to getting to the island.
Gnomonkey says Suqah can smack you around quite a bit, so you may need more food with worse defensive gear.

The fastest way to the Suqah is a lunar teleport portal at a player-owned house; Gnomonkey instead uses Fremennik sea boots and takes the boat to Lunar Isle, and a lyre or Relleka house teleport also work.
On arrival Gnomonkey drops his cannon on a specific tile, drinks his divine super combat, and turns on piety and protect from magic.
Suqah randomly use magic attacks that do little damage but freeze the player, which is annoying, so Gnomonkey protects from magic.
Gnomonkey recommends grabbing some Suqah teeth on a first task, as they are used to protect spirit trees from disease.
A task of 67 Suqah took Gnomonkey eight minutes, which he says is definitely one of the shorter tasks in the game.
Gnomonkey got 60k Slayer XP an hour on Suqah, which he calls incredibly good compared with most cannon tasks, but the loot was two rubies, about 6k gp.
Gnomonkey says you do not do Suqah tasks for the loot but the incredible XP easily makes up for it.
For Suqah Gnomonkey says Bandos can be downgraded to fighter torso and obsidian legs, primordial boots to dragon boots, ferocious gloves to Barrows gloves, and torture to fury.
Gnomonkey brings a gem sack but skips the herb sack on Suqah because they only drop low-value herbs like guam and marrentill.
Gnomonkey brings a Saradomin godsword, bone crusher, wrench and cannon for Suqah, plus a divine super combat and six prayer potions, filling the rest of the inventory with food as they drop no loot.
Gnomonkey brings a cannon for Suqah tasks and says the Slayer XP rate is incredibly good compared with most cannon tasks.
